text:
maria: Morning handoff — canary rollout (canary-42) started 08:05 UTC for embeddings-service in eu-west-1. Seeing spike in 5xx/errors, reducing latency for some customers but error rate up ~3.8% over baseline. I'm keeping primary traffic on stable model.

deploy-bot: Canary canary-42 deployed to eu-west-1 at 08:05 UTC (5% traffic).

alert-bot: [ALERT] embeddings-service eu-west-1 5xx rate = 3.8% over last 5m (threshold 1.0%). Incident ID: INC-2028-eu-embeds.

samir: digging into logs now — early signs point to a memory spike on pod replicas with sequence-length heavy requests. Pulling logs: `kubectl -n embeddings logs -l canary=canary-42 --tail=200`

kevin: thanks. If memory pressure, we can drop canary to 0% quickly: `rgctl traffic split set embeddings-service --canary 0` — that'll route everyone back to stable. Do we want to do immediate rollback or try mitigations for 10–15m?

jess: I can watch traces and error budget. If 5xx >2% for another 10m, I'd prefer to cut canary. I'm +1 to conservative rollback until root cause known.

samir: quick mitigation I'd try: throttle long-seq requests via the per-route limiter (reduce max_seq for canary) and increase replica memory request for canary pods. I pushed a quick k8s patch to add +2Gi to canary nodepool; still pulling pod restarts.

maria: plan: 1) samir continues log/root cause, 2) jess monitors SLO/alerts, 3) kevin stands by to run `rgctl traffic split set embeddings-service --canary 0` if 5xx stays high at T+15m (08:20 UTC), 4) I will post final decision in 15m.

kevin: acked. I'll be ready to execute rollback command; also have rollback playbook open: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeds-canary-rollback

samir: FYI — early suspicion: tokenization edge-case (long code blocks) causing KV cache bloat in new model variant. Adding a quick input-length guard in the canary routing layer now. Patch: `if seq_len > 4096: route->stable` — pushing in 2m.

jess: noted. I'll mute alert noise for paging and keep a watch channel open. If traffic drops to stable and errors normalize, we'll re-run canary with smaller seq-samples.

maria: handing off to night shift: samir will be primary until 09:00 UTC, jess monitoring SLOs, kevin on rollback. If anything escalates, page oncall and call me. Leaving the runbook link + incident ID above.

kevin: quick Q — do we want to capture a sample request for postmortem? samir, can you `kubectl cp` a sample payload to the incident ticket?

samir: yes grabbing a few failing request traces now and attaching to INC-2028-eu-embeds.

maria: thanks team — leaving short notes in the incident ticket and the runbook. Will check back at 08:20 UTC. :thumbsup:
